description: Alterations to front boundary wall, formation of hardstanding to front garden, new garden fence along boundary with no 81, new outbuilding on rear garden including pergola and the raising the roof of the rear garage and the insertion of two rooflights
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1584_P01, 1584_P04 and 1584_P06- received 26/09/20
1584_P02- 30/10/20
Tree report- received 25/11/20
1584_P05 A- received 18/02/20
1584_P03 D and 1584_P07- received 10/06/20) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby approved shall not be used for purposes other than those specified on the plans hereby approved or such uses which are incidental to the house at [83 Lionel Road North Brentford  TW8 9QZ]. For the avoidance of doubt the building shall not be used as a living room, bedroom, kitchen or as a separate unit of accommodation, nor for business purposes.
